title: 荆棘岭开路
subtitle: 慢一点，也能为后来的人留条路
origin: 《西游记》第六十四回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 遇到难走的路，合作整理、留下标记，不只帮助自己，也能让后来的人更安全。
moral.en: When a path is difficult, clearing it together and leaving markers helps us and everyone who comes after.

pages.zh: 荆棘岭的枝条长得密密麻麻，原来的山路只剩一条细缝。
pages.en: Branches grew thick across Bramble Ridge until the old mountain path became a narrow gap.
pages.prompt: Full Journey to the West team reaches a dense but sunlit bramble ridge where soft leafy branches cover a former broad path; no sharp threatening thorns, no text.

pages.zh: 悟空能一下跳过去，却发现白龙马和挑担的沙僧需要更宽、更平的路。
pages.en: Wukong could leap across, but White Dragon Horse and Sha carrying supplies needed a wider, smoother route.
pages.prompt: Wukong stands lightly on a rock while noticing White Dragon Horse and Sha Wujing need a wider safe passage; Tang Seng and Bajie assess the branches, no text.

pages.zh: 唐僧说：“能过得最快，不等于大家都能过。我们按最需要照顾的人来修路。”
pages.en: Tang Seng said, “The fastest way for one is not a path for all. Let us build for the one who needs the most care.”
pages.prompt: Tang Seng calmly gathers the full team in a planning circle beside the blocked trail, gesturing toward White Dragon Horse and supply baskets; no text.

pages.zh: 八戒用圆钝木耙把落叶扫到路边，沙僧把松动的石头稳稳垫平。
pages.en: Bajie used his rounded farm rake to move leaves aside, while Sha stabilized loose stones.
pages.prompt: Bajie safely rakes leaves with rounded farm tool and Sha uses broad round-edged spade to settle small stones; tools low and away from others, no text.

pages.zh: 悟空不砍活树，只把倒下的枯枝搬开，还为低垂的枝条系上软布带。
pages.en: Wukong did not cut living trees. He moved fallen branches and tied soft cloth bands around low boughs.
pages.prompt: Wukong carries one fallen dry branch while tying bright soft fabric around low living boughs to make them visible; staff shrunk safely behind ear, no text.

pages.zh: 白龙马先试走一遍。哪里容易绊脚，它就用蓝色蹄印牌提醒大家再检查。
pages.en: White Dragon Horse tested the route. Where footing felt uneven, it nudged a blue hoof marker for another check.
pages.prompt: White Dragon Horse with pearl-white coat, pale-blue mane and forehead diamond walks slowly on cleared path and nudges a blank blue hoof-shaped marker near an uneven spot; team checks, no text.

pages.zh: 树仙们也来帮忙，把修剪下的细枝编成扶手和小鸟休息架。
pages.en: The tree spirits joined in, weaving trimmed twigs into handrails and perches for birds.
pages.prompt: Friendly adult tree spirits with warm wooden-brown skin, leaf-green robes and branch-like hair cooperate with team to weave smooth twig handrails and bird perches; no frightening tree faces, no text.

pages.zh: 新山路终于能让马匹、老人和孩子安心通过。师徒留下彩带，继续赶路。
pages.en: The new path was safe for horses, elders, and children. The travelers left bright markers and continued on.
pages.prompt: A broad cleared forest trail with soft handrails and bright cloth markers welcomes an ancient family group while full team departs in warm sunset; inclusive access, no text.
